name: Thread Quest
whereItsAt: On the back burner since late 2024, after hitting a wall on affiliate marketing. In November 2026 I read every line of it again, wrote a rebuild plan, and shipped the first fix: user data now checks who is signed in.

lines: A full assessment and a rebuild plan.
User data now checks who is signed in.
Affiliate links paused until the program approves.
Several tries to get affiliate tracking working.

shoots.label: Buy inside the app
shoots.note: Later: buying without leaving the app. It needs legal work first, so for now each piece opens on the store's site.
